rules: Marriage never automatically transfers faction membership, office, property or allegiance.
Children receive one persistent identity at birth and deterministic inherited appearance/aptitudes; no rerolls.
Household movement, guardianship, widowhood, inheritance and succession claims are separate facts.

conception.rule: Within an existing consenting marriage, an eligible non-player household has one stable fertility month in each 18-month cycle. Failed checks are not persisted.

demographic_family_formation.rule: Ordinary non-player faction members may form a deterministic courtship from compatible local adults even when no prior exact social edge existed. Only the selected pair is materialized into social/family state.
